newsitem.title: USA: Apple names M. Mandich senior VP/Americas.
newsitem.headline: Apple names M. Mandich senior VP/Americas.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said Tuesday it named Mitch Mandich senior vice president of the Americas, where he will be responsible for sales activities in the United States, Canada, and Latin America.
He was previously vice president of the North America business division.
The company was not immediately able to provide information on whether Mandich's job is a new position.

"Mandich's role will be the focal point for the integration of sales and support activities in the Americas," said Dave Manovich, Apple's executive vice president of Worldwide Sales and Service, in a written statement.
In addition, Apple said it closed its first series of meetings with its customer advisory boards.

It said the attendees, representing some of the largest corporations in the U.S., discussed Apple's products and strategic direction and examined the impact of Apple's future technology on their business.
Attendees included Time Warner Inc, Viacom Inc, DuPont Co affiliate Dupont Scientific and Hallmark Inc.
Apple said it plans to continue the meetings on a quarterly basis.
